Kai (sales): Rivervista wants a commit recommendation. Workload: customer support chat (80%) + embeddings (20%). Peak 320 rps for 2h/day, baseline 90 rps otherwise. Target 95th latency <=350ms. Model: 13B quantized. Need baseline reserved GPUs, burst approach, and an autoscale snippet we can include in the SOW.
Marta (eng): Quick math: peak generation tokens ~320*0.8*100avg_tokens ~25.6k tokens/s. Conservative throughput for quantized 13B ~5k tokens/s per GPU. Baseline 90rps -> ~7.2k tokens/s -> need 2 GPUs baseline. Peak needs ~6 GPUs total to avoid queuing (25.6k/5k=5.1 -> 6).
Li (infra): Recommend reserve 2 GPUs as baseline. Offer burst-pack: reserved-burst + autoscale to add +1 GPU steps up to 4 (fast path) and allow ephemeral spot/backfill to reach 6 for extreme windows. Autoscale policy: scale up if 95th_latency >300ms for 30s OR queue_depth > 25% of baseline capacity; step size 1 GPU, cooldown 6m. Scale down after 12m stable under thresholds. Preheat KV cache 25m before expected window.
Omar (pricing): Pricing option A: commit 2 GPUs monthly + burst-pack (prepaid GPU-hours) to cover expected 2h/day peaks. Option B: commit 4 GPUs baseline (higher monthly) and smaller burst. I'll draft both quotes; note Private deployment pricing differs.
Tara (security): For Private/Dedicated HIPAA asks: confirm customer KMS, VPC peering, 1y audit logs, and that embeddings can be disabled for storage. Need Rivervista legal contact for BAA.
Kai (sales): I'll intro legal. Can we include a fallback policy for when ephemeral capacity unavailable?
Marta (eng): Fallback: automatic model-fallback to 7B quantized when scale cannot provision required GPUs within 45s; include a degradation notice header. Also allow graceful queueing with max queue time 8s before fallback.
ops-bot: Playbook created: https://redwood.internal/checklists/rivervista-poc-capacity (items: baseline-reserve, burst-pack, autoscale-policy, preheat, security-answers) :white_check_mark:
Kai (sales): Perfect. I'll send both quote options + ops playbook to Rivervista and schedule a 20m tech sync. Any blockers?
Marta (eng): None. If they insist on hard 350ms at 3x peak without extra capacity that's a commercial negotiation.
Omar (pricing): I'll attach quotes today.
